name: Gun Range Idle 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Gun Range Idle is a casual game where you'll experience the thrill of unlocking and upgrading a wide variety of guns while earning money and leveling up to unlock exciting features. In this casual idle game, your goal is to become the ultimate gun aficionado by mastering the art of shooting and collecting an impressive arsenal of firearms.
